scheme_name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme For North Eastern Region
other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of North Eastern Region
Parental annual income must not exceed ₹4,50,000 per annum
Must have passed Class 12th or equivalent in the preceding year of study
Must have secured admission in the first year of any degree course

Scholarship is limited to general degree, technical, professional, medical or paramedical courses at institutions recognized under UGC Act (Section 2(f) & 12 B, deemed universities, government‑funded institutions, institutes of national importance, or other statutory council‑recognized institutions) that have an AISHE code
Renewal is subject to good conduct, prescribed attendance and submission of an annual progress report
Change of course of study results in forfeiture of the scholarship
Transgender candidates are eligible to apply
Reservations for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, general and Persons with Disability will be as per Government of India norms
benefits_summary: Provides monthly scholarship of ₹5,400 for general degree courses and ₹7,800 for technical/medical/professional courses to eligible NE students.
